name: When should I repair or replace my shower faucet?

mainEntity.name: When should I repair or replace my shower faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider repairing your shower faucet if the issue is minor, such as a leaking O-ring, or if the faucet is relatively new and in good condition. Replacement is often more cost-effective if the faucet is old, has significant corrosion, multiple components are failing, or if you desire a different style or updated features. If repair costs approach or exceed half the cost of a new, similar quality faucet, replacement might be the better long-term solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair if the issue is minor or the faucet is new; replace if it's old, corroded, has multiple failures, or if repair costs are high.
